# Build constraints for reuse 6.2.0 in licence-check.yml. reuse's one wheel
# installs only on CPython 3.10 under glibc 2.41 or later, so CI builds it from
# its source archive, with poetry-core: the release a fresh build resolved on
# 3 October 2026. uv checks no hashes when it installs a tool, so it is held by
# version.
poetry-core==2.5.0
